designDecisions: The package public surface is derived at import from each module's own __all__ and refuses an empty export list, an undefined listed name, and two different objects under one name, because a hand-copied 431-name list is a second API that drifts silently.

Contract concept names map onto code names, and the mapping is recorded in each module docstring: ConstraintPredicate -> predicates.PredicateSignature + PredicateCall; ConditionalConstraint -> Constraint.conditions; ProtectedSemanticZone/AnchorRef -> constraints.ProtectedAnchor; MinimumSufficientExecutionSlice -> execution.ExecutionIntentSlice; SemanticDelta -> fingerprints.IntentDelta.

identity.RefKind was extended with the ref kinds the frozen S03-S05 concepts require (PROVENANCE, OBLIGATION, CONTRACT_SET, READINESS, LEASE, RECEIPT and the M01/M02/HIVE-shaped refs) instead of overloading an existing kind: a ref that misnames its target is the one error a trust boundary cannot recover from. This is an additive vocabulary extension inside the freeze, not a change to any frozen invariant.

constraints.KNOWN_CHANNELS is computed from the ModalChannel enum minus CROSS and UNSPECIFIED rather than listed by hand, so a modality can never again exist as a statement channel and not as a rule scope.
ConstraintBundle admission is two steps (construct, then .admit(registry=, admitted_by=)) so no bundle can exist half-admitted, and RevisionFrozenError guards the second step.
IntentOrigin.DEFAULTED floors at PROJECT_RECORD rather than at the inference ceiling: a default is a value someone stands behind, not a model guess.

A blocking conflict and a mandatory human question are reported by the same seven-family readiness report, so 'not asked' cannot be read as 'clean': report.ready requires zero findings and all seven ReadinessFamily members assessed.

Slice purposes carry their own closure debts (needs_constraints / needs_ambiguity / needs_provenance), which is how the token-economy requirement in section 15 became a testable property instead of a style note.

failuresEncounteredAndFixed.symptom: The self-promotion guard called is_untrusted(AuthorityLevel) with an enum instead of a value, so it raised for every statement at every authority level and the section 5.6 SELF_PROMOTED_RULE refusal was unreachable code.
failuresEncounteredAndFixed.resolution: Now keyed on AuthorityLevel.self_asserting_is_enough plus the statement's confidence, so machine-backed authority is refused as data and self-asserting levels pass. Tests that had pinned the crash were rewritten to pin the correct refusal; no invariant was relaxed.

failuresEncounteredAndFixed.symptom: A finding message read record.consequence.value where consequence is already a string, raising AttributeError while building an AmbiguityBlockedError.
failuresEncounteredAndFixed.resolution: Message now uses the label directly; the blocking-ambiguity path is exercised end to end in tests/test_m03_ambiguity.py.

failuresEncounteredAndFixed.symptom: Blocking-gap severity was produced by calling M01's DefectSeverity.parse with one argument where the M01 parser requires two, so the constraint layer crashed instead of classifying a violation.
failuresEncounteredAndFixed.resolution: A single kernel-local mapper supplies the M01 severity vocabulary with its required basis, keeping M01 the authority on what the words mean.

failuresEncounteredAndFixed.symptom: The hand-listed channel tuple had drifted from its own documented invariant: MUSIC existed as a statement modality and not as a rule scope, so the section 6 narration-and-music brief could state a music fact but could not bind a rule to it.
failuresEncounteredAndFixed.resolution: Derived from ModalChannel minus CROSS/UNSPECIFIED, with the drift pinned by a subset test in both directions.

failuresEncounteredAndFixed.symptom: When M01 refused instantiate() or resolve(), the bridge appended a gap after the spec had been built and returned it with the stale spec, so FidelityCompilation.__post_init__ raised SchemaValidationError instead of reporting the refusal. The invariant (compilation gaps and spec gaps are one list) is correct; the failure path violated it.
failuresEncounteredAndFixed.resolution: The three INCOMPLETE returns now carry replace(spec, gaps=tuple(gaps)), so an emission refusal surfaces as a typed gap with its remedy.

failuresEncounteredAndFixed.symptom: ScopeSplitProposal's empty-branch ScopeError is unreachable in practice: SplitBranch.party_refs requires at least one bound ref and ScopeSplitProposal refuses a party listed in two branches, so an empty branch cannot be constructed.
failuresEncounteredAndFixed.resolution: Recorded as an observation for the reviewer. No code changed; the reachable refusals (empty branch rejected at the branch boundary, duplicated party rejected at the split) are pinned by tests.

risksAndDeferredWork: The twelve section 12 extension boundaries are types and opaque-ref contracts, not integrations: no provider, DCC, rights system, brand store, canon engine or delivery backend is wired, so every cross-module claim in M03 is a reference the caller must keep honest.
stores ships in-memory reference repositories only; there is no persistence, CAS, database or HIVE write path, by section 19.

Semantic freshness, reuse equivalence and release readiness are evaluated against dependencies the caller supplies; a production that supplies no DerivedIntentDependency gets an unassessed family, not a clean bill.
Explanation graphs are built and validated but not stored or exported; the ExplanationExportPort is a boundary without an implementation.
Override and lease ledgers are append-only structures with no clock: expiry is revision-scoped (expires_after_revision), so calendar expiry must be decided by a caller that owns a clock.
No performance or token measurement is claimed anywhere: slice minimality is proven structurally (which closures a purpose owes, and that an unrelated statement cannot ride along), not by benchmark.

proof.m01RemainsQualityAuthority: iris_intent.versions.QualityClass is iris_quality.contracts.QualityClass (same object, asserted by tests). The kernel imports eight M01 submodules for vocabulary, M01's own payload validator and the registry it consults; it never instantiates DecisionEngine, EvaluatorRegistry, JudgeRequest, DomainProfile or DimensionRegistry (grep-verified: zero construction sites), never computes or mutates a score, and never registers an evaluator or a dimension. compile_fidelity_contract treats evaluator_registry.resolve(contract) as the authority boundary and records MISSING_EVALUATOR_CAPABILITY when it refuses; require_no_downgrade refuses a QualityClassRequest whose basis is scarcity, cost or provider convenience; a spec with blocking gaps returns INCOMPLETE with those gaps instead of emitting a weaker contract. Pinned by tests/test_m03_fidelity.py (94).
proof.m02AuthorityBoundary: Zero imports of iris_project_os in iris_intent (the two textual hits are docstrings, one of which states base.py mirrors rather than imports it). M02-owned facts - branch, variant, rollback topology, snapshots, build and lifecycle - enter only as versioned opaque refs through ports.ProjectGraphPort, and SemanticMutationClass describes which semantic dimensions an edit moves without claiming what the graph looks like afterwards. Pinned by tests/test_m03_transport.py (90) and the import scan in tests/test_m03_domain_neutrality.py.
proof.noProviderRuntimeLeakage: Every kernel file is discovered twice (filesystem glob and pkgutil) and parsed with ast; the union of top-level import roots is a subset of the standard library plus iris_quality, iris_project_os and iris_intent, and none of the forbidden provider/DCC/cloud/database/web namespaces (torch, tensorflow, diffusers, cv2, PIL, numpy, bpy, maya, unreal, comfyui, ollama, openai, anthropic, boto3, google, azure, sqlalchemy, psycopg, pymongo, redis, requests, httpx, aiohttp, fastapi, flask) appears. A second scan forbids the strings 'm03_synthetic_profiles' and 'examples.' inside the package, so fixtures cannot leak inward. Determinism is mechanical too: no kernel module imports time, datetime, random, os, socket, subprocess, threading, multiprocessing, asyncio, pathlib, sqlite3, http, urllib or secrets; the only entropy helper, identity.mint_id, is documented as deliberately unused inside the kernel and is never called by a compilation path.
proof.sixSyntheticProfiles: See sixSyntheticProfiles: six section 6 domains through one branch-free runner producing six distinct digests, with one blocking conflict and one mandatory human decision, driven by tests/test_m03_synthetic_profiles.py and tests/test_m03_domain_neutrality.py; a seventh invented domain compiles through the same calls with no kernel change.
proof.tokenSliceEfficiency: SlicePurpose declares its own closure debts (needs_constraints = COMPILE_QUALITY/COMPILE_EXECUTION/RESOLVE_CONFLICT/VALIDATE, needs_ambiguity = CLARIFY/RESOLVE_CONFLICT/AUDIT, needs_provenance = AUDIT/CLARIFY), require_slice_minimality refuses a slice carrying an unrelated statement, and the compile-vs-audit comparison test shows the closure changes with purpose while the statements stay the same. Measured on the six profiles: slices of 1 statement with 1 to 3 rules, where a film brief pulls a third rule only because its condition is satisfied. Fingerprints exclude provider/model/host/worker/runtime/cost observations via execution.FINGERPRINT_EXCLUSIONS, and reuse.evaluate_reuse returns REUSE_EQUIVALENT for a testified source-only rewording while an untestified one demands RECOMPILE, so a recompile is earned by proof rather than by silence.
proof.semanticAdmissionShield: AuthorityLevel knows which levels are self-asserting (GOVERNED_POLICY, HUMAN_OWNER only); every machine-backed level (UNTRUSTED, PROVIDER_OBSERVED, RETRIEVED, MODEL_INFERRED) plus an INFERRED origin yields a REFUSED SELF_PROMOTED_RULE finding naming 'confidence is not authority', with evidence refs, and the shield is exercised over an explicit admissible origin-to-level table so no admissible combination raises. Constraints cannot be HARD on machine authority, RETRIEVED/UNTRUSTED cannot back a mandatory rule, unknown predicates fail closed at bundle.admit(), arbitrary executable text is refused by predicates.reject_interpolation, scope is refused as authority by require_no_authority_in_scope, condition nesting is bounded by require_bounded_nesting, and blocking ambiguity is refused before a contract can be compiled. Pinned by tests/test_m03_identity.py (49), test_m03_constraints.py (95) and test_m03_ambiguity.py (54).
